`r if (mode_demo()) "**SYNTHETIC DATA: technical demonstration only.**"`

# S1. Data provenance

Source file: `r ids$fichier`. SHA-256: `r ids$sha256`. Weeks 1–`r ids$semaine_max` of 2026; `r format(ids$n_brut, big.mark = ",")` rows; `r dplyr::n_distinct(ids$donnees$zs)` health zones. Confirmed EVD counts by zone and province (situation report `r cfg$epidemie$sitrep_exposition`, INSP-COUSP, 14 August 2026) were transcribed from the MSF report for weeks 32–33 of 2026, not from the primary report. **The primary report should be consulted before submission.**

# S2. Data cleaning log

```{r journal}
ids$journal |>
  dplyr::transmute(Rule = regle, Occurrences = n, Action = action) |>
  flextable() |> tab_style() |> align(j = c(1, 3), align = "left", part = "all")
```

# S3. Zones with loss of malaria confirmation

```{r ruptures}
ids$ruptures |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(debut_rupture) | conf_egal_susp) |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(R$expo, zs, mve), by = "zs") |>
  dplyr::arrange(debut_rupture) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Zone = nom_zone(zs), `Pre-outbreak median ratio` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * positivite_base),
                   `Confirmed = suspected at baseline` = ifelse(conf_egal_susp, "Yes", "No"),
                   `Onset week` = debut_rupture, `Confirmed EVD cases` = mve) |>
  flextable() |> tab_style()
```

# S4. Reconciliation with the published week 32 report

Differences reflect late reports added after publication and the cleaning rules. The transcribed report is in `data/external/rapport_s32_reference.csv`.

```{r rapprochement}
rapprocher_reference(ids, cfg) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Disease = lab(maladie), `Report: week 32` = S32, `Database: week 32` = S32_base,
                   `Report: cumulative cases` = cumul_2026, `Database: cumulative cases` = cumul_base,
                   `Difference, %` = ifelse(is.na(ecart_pct), "–", sprintf("%.1f", ecart_pct)),
                   `Report: deaths` = deces_2026, `Database: deaths` = deces_base) |>
  flextable() |> tab_style(7.5)
```

# S5. Exposure by health zone and agreement with routine haemorrhagic fever notifications

Routine notifications are cumulative to week `r cfg$epidemie$semaine_exposition`. Spearman ρ = `r sprintf("%.2f", R$concordance$rho)` for counts and `r sprintf("%.2f", R$concordance$rho_inc)` for incidence. Discordant zones may reflect where cases are reported, how they are classified, or data errors, and should be reviewed with zone teams.

```{r expo}
R$expo |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mve)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Zone = nom_zone(zs), Population = format(pop, big.mark = ","), `Confirmed EVD cases` = mve,
                   `Per 10,000` = sprintf("%.1f", inc), `Routine AHF notifications` = fha, Group = as.character(groupe)) |>
  flextable() |> tab_style(7.5)
```

# S6. Sensitivity analyses

```{r fig-sens, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=8.4, fig.cap="Figure S1. Sensitivity of the ratio of rate ratios (10 EVD cases per 10,000 versus none; case-count exposure: 100 cases versus none). Vertical line: no association. Bars: 95% CI; log scale."}
sens <- lapply(codes, function(k) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::select(res[[k]]$principal, rrr, bas, haut), analyse = "Main analysis"),
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::select(res[[k]]$gamm$contraste, rrr, bas, haut), analyse = "Negative binomial mixed model"),
    dplyr::select(res[[k]]$sensibilite$table, rrr, bas, haut, analyse)
  ) |> dplyr::mutate(issue = lab(k))
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()
niveaux <- rev(c("Main analysis", "Negative binomial mixed model", setdiff(unique(sens$analyse), c("Main analysis", "Negative binomial mixed model"))))
sens <- dplyr::mutate(sens, analyse = factor(analyse, levels = niveaux), issue = factor(issue, levels = lab(codes)))
ggplot(sens, aes(rrr, analyse)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = COUL$axe, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = bas, xmax = haut), colour = COUL$serie1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(colour = COUL$serie1, size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~issue, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Ratio of rate ratios (log scale)", y = NULL) +
  theme_rapport(8) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = COUL$grille, linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5))
```

```{r tab-sens}
sens |>
  dplyr::mutate(v = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", rrr, bas, haut)) |>
  dplyr::select(analyse, issue, v) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = issue, values_from = v) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(analyse)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(analyse = as.character(analyse)) |>
  dplyr::rename(Analysis = analyse) |>
  flextable() |> tab_style(6.5)
```

# S7. Categorical exposure

Rate ratios relative to zones without EVD. The threshold of 50 cases is arbitrary and is used for description only.

```{r categ}
lapply(codes, function(k) {
  x <- res[[k]]$sensibilite$categories
  tibble::tibble(Outcome = lab(k),
                 `1–49 EVD cases` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", x$rrr[1], x$bas[1], x$haut[1]),
                 `≥50 EVD cases` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", x$rrr[2], x$bas[2], x$haut[2]),
                 `Leave-one-zone-out range` = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", res[[k]]$sensibilite$loo[1], res[[k]]$sensibilite$loo[2]))
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows() |> flextable() |> tab_style()
```

# S8. Model diagnostics

Lag-1 autocorrelation of randomised quantile residuals from the negative binomial mixed model. Residual autocorrelation supports using zone-clustered inference and permutation tests in the main analysis, rather than model-based standard errors.

```{r diag}
lapply(codes, function(k) tibble::tibble(Outcome = lab(k), `Negative binomial size` = sprintf("%.1f", res[[k]]$gamm$theta),
                                         `Residual lag-1 autocorrelation` = sprintf("%.2f", res[[k]]$gamm$ac1),
                                         `Pre-trend P` = sprintf("%.3f", res[[k]]$evenement$p_pre),
                                         `Observations` = res[[k]]$principal$n_obs,
                                         `Zones` = res[[k]]$principal$n_zs)) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |> flextable() |> tab_style()
```
